verdict_scope: All 16 reviewed rows are void for every purpose: training, agreement baseline, and as a starting point for any pilot.
verified_ok: Server-side instance_cls_auxiliary.csv hash matches its manifest exactly (ae3a2ac8..., 2207 rows + header) at /root/autodl-tmp/nailfold/artifacts/experiments/model-upgrade-20260831/.

findings.title: locked-47 derivative images were reviewed
findings.detail: Reviewed 13.jpg and 179.jpg are EXCLUDE_LOCKED_OVERLAP in locked_exclusion_manifest.csv ('exact image overlap with v1 locked case; original and all derivatives excluded'). 32 of 582 queue rows are locked-overlap, 21 labelled usable. The exclusion manifest, present since 2026-08-30, was not applied.

findings.title: leakage surface is undecidable, not merely bounded
findings.detail: final_status.json says locked_exclusion_complete_for_detected_overlap: true; the qualifier 'detected' carries the whole claim. source_case_unknown_or_unlisted: 454. 449/582 are UNMAPPED_LOCAL_SOURCE so their locked status cannot be decided. Leakage lower bound 32, upper bound unknown.

findings.title: governance holds bypassed
findings.detail: Of 16 reviewed: 11 HOLD (blocking_reason cites source case, permission, label semantics), 2 EXCLUDE_LOCKED_OVERLAP, 1 HOLD_DUPLICATE_LABEL_CONFLICT, 2 PASS_AUXILIARY_CONDITIONALLY. Top-level state is HOLD_NO_UNCONDITIONAL_TRAIN_ASSETS, unconditional_safe_train_assets: 0.

findings.title: selection is deterministic, not a sample, and circular
findings.detail: Reviewed indices [3,11,12,24,25,34,35,37,40,42,64,88,97,100,101,105] are exactly the first 16 quality_label=='usable' rows in filename order. The heuristic (edge_variance>=180 -> usable) picked them; the reviewer confirmed all 16 usable; 'unusable' never occurred. Reviewed edge_variance min 182.2 vs pending mean 132.8. All 433 'uncertain' images were never viewed, so the heuristic remains untested.

findings.title: agreement against existing human annotation never computed
findings.detail: All 582 images carry XML boxes (vessel / cross_vessel / malformed_vessel); reviewed images hold 2-12 boxes each. No kappa, no IoU. This was the designated gate and it was skipped.

findings.title: two label fields carry zero independent information
findings.detail: measurement_visibility == loop_boundary on 16/16 rows despite the protocol defining different value domains (unusable vs absent). Using both as features double-counts one signal.

findings.title: protocol rule not executable at image level
findings.detail: Rule 1 ('complete requires both visible apex and both descending limbs') is per-vessel, but labels are per-image over 2-12 vessels with no aggregation rule. 13.jpg: 12 boxes marked complete; 194.jpg: 2 marked partial. Not reproducible as written.

findings.title: protocol's own required fields absent
findings.detail: Protocol v1 defines clarity_review; no such column in the CSV. Provenance section requires a per-row timestamp; no timestamp column.

findings.title: manifest reviewed_rows is wrong
findings.detail: Manifest claims reviewed_rows: 31. Measured: review_status!=pending 16, non-null reviewer 16, non-null annotation_confidence 16, measurement_visibility!=unknown 16. 31 matches no statistic in the file. File hash verifies, so the manifest is wrong rather than the CSV altered.

findings.title: canonical deduplication not applied
findings.detail: 582 rows hold 570 unique sha256: 10 duplicate-content groups (22 rows) plus 2 NaN. Reviewed 190.jpg is byte-identical to pending 400.jpg; locked 13.jpg identical to 321.jpg. Duplicate content crosses any split if labels propagate.

findings.title: review resolution likely insufficient
findings.detail: usable_contact_sheet_16.jpg is 960x760 holding 16 tiles, ~240x190 each, ~6% of the ~1000x750 source pixels; a 62x170px vessel box scales to ~18x52px. Graded L2 because the script producing the queue and contact sheet is not in the repo (only the aux-CSV builder), so it cannot be confirmed the reviewer saw only the thumbnail. Confidence: medium 12 / low 4 / high 0; under protocol rule 3 the 4 low rows should have been unknown.

findings.title: no case-level linkage
findings.detail: Queue is image-level with no exam_case_id column. Under unique key = exam_case_id + field these labels cannot enter case-level evaluation. Locked exclusion must happen at case level, which is why 13 and 179 slipped through.

findings.title: two truncated images, recoverable
findings.detail: 418.jpg and 423.jpg are both exactly 524288 bytes (2^19), i.e. truncated in transfer rather than corrupt at source. Both correctly flagged quality_label=unknown by v1.

findings.title: no version control
findings.detail: Project root is not a git repository (git rev-parse: fatal). find /root -name '*visual_review*' on the main server returns nothing. These annotations existed only on one local machine with no version history.

not_verified: Whether the 449 UNMAPPED_LOCAL_SOURCE images overlap locked-47 - undecidable with current provenance records.
What the v1 reviewer actually saw, at what resolution - generating script absent from repo.
Whether permission exists for auxiliary use of the 11 HOLD images whose blocking_reason cites permission.
